verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.e2b.dev that indexes the documentation, and per-page markdown versions (e.g. quickstart.md) that point agents back to that index. Many cited docs pages are served as .md URLs, so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-readable docs. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or other single-file full-docs bundle, and no independent or community corroboration of agents using these docs.
